methods.name: Insert
methods.signature: Insert(Index As Long, SegmentType As MsoSegmentType, EditingType As MsoEditingType, X1 As Single, Y1 As Single, [X2 As Single], [Y2 As Single], [X3 As Single], [Y3 As Single])
methods.description: Inserts a node into a freeform shape.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Long. The number of the shape node after which to insert a new node.

parameters.name: SegmentType
parameters.description: The segment type.

parameters.name: EditingType
parameters.description: The editing type.

parameters.name: X1
parameters.description: If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingAuto, this argument specifies the horizontal distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the end point of the new segment. If the _EditingType_ of the new node is msoEditingCorner, this argument specifies the horizontal distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the first control point for the new segment.

parameters.name: Y1
parameters.description: If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingAuto, this argument specifies the vertical distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the end point of the new segment. If the _EditingType_ of the new node is msoEditingCorner, this argument specifies the vertical distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the first control point for the new segment.

parameters.name: X2
parameters.description: If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingCorner, this argument specifies the horizontal distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the second control point for the new segment. If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingAuto, don't specify a value for this argument.

parameters.name: Y2
parameters.description: If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingCorner, this argument specifies the vertical distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the second control point for the new segment. If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingAuto, don't specify a value for this argument.

parameters.name: X3
parameters.description: If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingCorner, this argument specifies the horizontal distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the end point of the new segment. If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingAuto, don't specify a value for this argument.

parameters.name: Y3
parameters.description: If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingCorner, this argument specifies the vertical distance, measured in points, from the upper-left corner of the document to the end point of the new segment. If the _EditingType_ of the new segment is msoEditingAuto, don't specify a value for this argument.

methods.name: SetEditingType
methods.signature: SetEditingType(Index As Long, EditingType As MsoEditingType)
methods.description: Sets the editing type of the node specified by _Index_. If the node is a control point for a curved segment, this method sets the editing type of the node adjacent to it that joins two segments. Note that, depending on the editing type, this method may affect the position of adjacent nodes.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The node whose editing type is to be set.

parameters.name: EditingType
parameters.description: The editing property of the vertex.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.signature: SetPosition(Index As Long, X1 As Single, Y1 As Single)
methods.description: Sets the location of the node specified by _Index_. Note that, depending on the editing type of the node, this method may affect the position of adjacent nodes.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The node whose position is to be set.

parameters.name: X1
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the new node relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Y1
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the new node relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

methods.name: SetSegmentType
methods.signature: SetSegmentType(Index As Long, SegmentType As MsoSegmentType)
methods.description: Sets the segment type of the segment that follows the node specified by _Index_. If the node is a control point for a curved segment, this method sets the segment type for that curve. Note that this may affect the total number of nodes by inserting or deleting adjacent nodes.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The node whose segment type is to be set.

parameters.name: SegmentType
parameters.description: Specifies if the segment is straight or curved.

types.name: ShapeRange
types.description: Represents a shape range, which is a set of shapes on a document.
types.remarks: A shape range can contain as few as a single shape or as many as all the shapes on the document. You can include whichever shapes you want-chosen from among all the shapes on the document or all the shapes in the selection-to construct a shape range. For example, you could construct a ShapeRange collection that contains the first three shapes on a document, all the selected shapes on a document, or all the freeforms on a document.
types.example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
myDocument.Shapes.Range(Array(1, 3)).Fill.Patterned _
 msoPatternHorizontalBrick

properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Adjustments
properties.description: Returns an Adjustments object that contains adjustment values for all the adjustments in the specified shape. Applies to any ShapeRange object that represents an AutoShape, WordArt, or Connector.

properties.name: TextFrame
properties.description: Returns a TextFrame object that contains the alignment and anchoring properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoShapeType
properties.description: Returns or sets the shape type for the specified Shape or ShapeRange object, which must represent an AutoShape other than a line, freeform drawing, or connector. Read/write MsoAutoShapeType.

properties.name: Callout
properties.description: Returns a CalloutFormat object that contains callout formatting properties for the specified shape. Applies to ShapeRange objects that represent line callouts. Read-only.

properties.name: ConnectionSiteCount
properties.description: Returns the number of connection sites on the specified shape. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Connector
properties.description: True if the specified shape is a connector. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: ConnectorFormat
properties.description: Returns a ConnectorFormat object that contains connector formatting properties. Applies to ShapeRange objects that represent connectors. Read-only.

properties.name: Fill
properties.description: Returns a FillFormat object for a specified shape or a ChartFillFormat object for a specified chart that contains fill formatting properties for the shape or chart. Read-only.

properties.name: GroupItems
properties.description: Returns a GroupShapes object that represents the individual shapes in the specified group. Use the Item method of the GroupShapes object to return a single shape from the group. Applies to ShapeRange objects that represent grouped shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single value that represents the height, in points, of the object.

properties.name: HorizontalFlip
properties.description: True if the specified shape is flipped around the horizontal axis. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Line
properties.description: Returns a LineFormat object that contains line formatting properties for the specified shape. (For a line, the LineFormat object represents the line itself; for a shape with a border, the LineFormat object represents the border). Read-only.

properties.name: LockAspectRatio
properties.description: True if the specified shape retains its original proportions when you resize it. False if you can change the height and width of the shape independently of one another when you resize it. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: Nodes
properties.description: Returns a ShapeNodes collection that represents the geometric description of the specified shape.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the shape, in degrees. Read/write Single.

properties.name: PictureFormat
properties.description: Returns a PictureFormat object that contains picture formatting properties for the specified shape. Applies to a ShapeRange object that represent pictures or OLE objects. Read-only.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns a read-only ShadowFormat object that contains shadow formatting properties for the specified shape or shapes.

properties.name: TextEffect
properties.description: Returns a TextEffectFormat object that contains text-effect formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns a ThreeDFormat object that contains 3D-effect formatting properties for the specified shape. Read-only.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the topmost shape in the shape range to the top edge of the worksheet.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns an MsoShapeType value that represents the shape type.

properties.name: VerticalFlip
properties.description: True if the specified shape is flipped around the vertical axis. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: Vertices
properties.description: Returns the coordinates of the specified freeform drawing's vertices (and control points for Bzier curves) as a series of coordinate pairs. Use the array returned by this property as an argument to the AddCurve method or AddPolyLine method. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single value that represents the width, in points, of the object.

properties.name: ZOrderPosition
properties.description: Returns the position of the specified shape in the z-order. Read-only Long.

properties.name: BlackWhiteMode
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates how the specified shape appears when the presentation is viewed in black-and-white mode. Read/write MsoBlackWhiteMode.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the descriptive (alternative) text string for a ShapeRange object when the object is saved to a webpage. Read/write String.

properties.name: Child
properties.description: Returns msoTrue if the specified shape is a child shape or if all shapes in a shape range are child shapes of the same parent. Returns msoFalse if the selected shape is not a child shape. Returns msoTriStateMixed if only some of the selected shapes are child shapes. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: ParentGroup
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the common parent shape of a child shape or a range of child shapes.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the type for the specified object.

properties.name: Chart
properties.description: Returns a Chart object that represents the chart contained in the shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: HasChart
properties.description: Returns whether a shape range contains a chart. Read-only MsoTriState.

properties.name: TextFrame2
properties.description: Returns a TextFrame2 object that contains text formatting for the specified shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: ShapeStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoShapeStyleIndex value that represents the shape style of the shape range. Read/write.

properties.name: BackgroundStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the background style. Read/write MsoBackgroundStyleIndex.

properties.name: SoftEdge
properties.description: Returns a SoftEdgeFormat object for a specified shape range that contains soft edge formatting properties for the shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: Glow
properties.description: Returns a GlowFormat object for a specified shape range that contains glow formatting properties for the shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: Reflection
properties.description: Returns a ReflectionFormat object for a specified shape range that contains reflection formatting properties for the shape range. Read-only.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns or sets the title of the alternative text associated with the specified shape range. Read/write.

properties.name: GraphicStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoGraphicStyleIndex constant that represents the style of a shape range containing one or more SVG graphics. Read/write.

properties.name: Model3D
properties.description: Returns a Model3DFormat object that contains Model3D properties. Read-only.

properties.name: Decorative
properties.description: Sets or returns the decorative flag for the specified object. Read/write.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.

methods.name: Align
methods.signature: Align(AlignCmd As MsoAlignCmd, RelativeTo As MsoTriState)
methods.description: Aligns the shapes in the specified range of shapes.

parameters.name: AlignCmd
parameters.description: Specifies the way that the shapes in the specified shape range are to be aligned.

parameters.name: RelativeTo
parameters.description: Not used in Microsoft Excel. Must be False.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies to the specified shape formatting that's been copied by using the PickUp method.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the object.

methods.name: Distribute
methods.signature: Distribute(DistributeCmd As MsoDistributeCmd, RelativeTo As MsoTriState)
methods.description: Horizontally or vertically distributes the shapes in the specified range of shapes.

parameters.name: DistributeCmd
parameters.description: Specifies whether shapes in the range are to be distributed horizontally or vertically.

parameters.name: RelativeTo
parameters.description: Not used in Microsoft Excel. Must be False.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates the object and returns a reference to the new copy.

methods.name: Flip
methods.description: Flips the specified shape around its horizontal or vertical axis.

parameters.name: FlipCmd
parameters.description: Specifies whether the shape is to be flipped horizontally or vertically.

methods.name: IncrementLeft
methods.description: Moves the specified shape horizontally by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be moved horizontally, in points. A positive value moves the shape to the right; a negative value moves it to the left.

methods.name: IncrementRotation
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the z-axis by the specified number of degrees. Use the Rotation property to set the absolute rotation of the shape.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape is to be rotated horizontally, in degrees. A positive value rotates the shape clockwise; a negative value rotates it counterclockwise.

methods.name: IncrementTop
methods.description: Moves the specified shape vertically by the specified number of points.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how far the shape object is to be moved vertically, in points. A positive value moves the shape down; a negative value moves it up.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Groups the shapes in the specified range.

methods.name: PickUp
methods.description: Copies the formatting of the specified shape. Use the Apply method to apply the copied formatting to another shape.

methods.name: RerouteConnections
methods.description: This method reroutes all connectors attached to the specified shape; if the specified shape is a connector, it's rerouted.

methods.name: Regroup
methods.description: Regroups the group that the specified shape range belonged to previously. Returns the regrouped shapes as a single Shape object.

methods.name: ScaleHeight
methods.signature: ScaleHeight(Factor As Single, RelativeToOriginalSize As MsoTriState, [Scale As Variant])
methods.description: Scales the height of the shape by a specified factor. For pictures and OLE objects, you can indicate whether you want to scale the shape relative to the original or the current size. Shapes other than pictures and OLE objects are always scaled relative to their current height.

parameters.name: Factor
parameters.description: Specifies the ratio between the height of the shape after you resize it and the current or original height. For example, to make a rectangle 50 percent larger, specify 1.5 for this argument.

parameters.name: RelativeToOriginalSize
parameters.description: msoTrue to scale the shape relative to its original size. msoFalse to scale it relative to its current size. You can specify msoTrue for this argument only if the specified shape is a picture or an OLE object.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: One of the constants of MsoScaleFrom, which specifies which part of the shape retains its position when the shape is scaled.

methods.name: ScaleWidth
methods.signature: ScaleWidth(Factor As Single, RelativeToOriginalSize As MsoTriState, [Scale As Variant])
methods.description: Scales the width of the shape by a specified factor. For pictures and OLE objects, you can indicate whether you want to scale the shape relative to the original or the current size. Shapes other than pictures and OLE objects are always scaled relative to their current width.

parameters.name: Factor
parameters.description: Specifies the ratio between the width of the shape after you resize it and the current or original width. For example, to make a rectangle 50 percent larger, specify 1.5 for this argument.

parameters.name: RelativeToOriginalSize
parameters.description: msoFalse to scale it relative to its current size. You can specify msoTrue for this argument only if the specified shape is a picture or an OLE object.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: One of the constants of MsoScaleFrom, which specifies which part of the shape retains its position when the shape is scaled.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the object.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: (used only with sheets). True to replace the current selection with the specified object. False to extend the current selection to include any previously selected objects and the specified object.

methods.name: SetShapesDefaultProperties
methods.description: Makes the formatting of the specified shape the default formatting for the shape.

methods.name: Ungroup
methods.description: Ungroups any grouped shapes in the specified shape or range of shapes. Disassembles pictures and OLE objects within the specified shape or range of shapes.

methods.name: ZOrder
methods.description: Moves the specified shape in front of or behind other shapes in the collection (that is, changes the shape's position in the z-order).

parameters.name: ZOrderCmd
parameters.description: Specifies where to move the specified shape relative to the other shapes.

types.name: Shapes
types.description: A collection of all the Shape objects on the specified sheet.
types.remarks: Each Shape object represents an object in the drawing layer, such as an AutoShape, freeform, OLE object, or picture.
types.example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
myDocument.Shapes.SelectAll

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents a subset of the shapes in a Shapes collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.

methods.name: AddCallout
methods.signature: AddCallout(Type As MsoCalloutType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a borderless line callout. Returns a Shape object that represents the new callout.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of callout line.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the callout's bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the callout's bounding box relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the callout's bounding box, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the callout's bounding box, in points.

methods.name: AddConnector
methods.signature: AddConnector(Type As MsoConnectorType, BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a connector. Returns a Shape object that represents the new connector. When a connector is added, it's not connected to anything. Use the BeginConnect and EndConnect methods to attach the beginning and end of a connector to other shapes in the document.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The connector type to add.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The horizontal position (in points) of the connector's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The vertical position (in points) of the connector's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The horizontal position (in points) of the connector's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The vertical position (in points) of the connector's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

methods.name: AddCurve
methods.description: Returns a Shape object that represents a Bzier curve on a worksheet.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the vertices and control points of the curve. The first point that you specify is the starting vertex, and the next two points are control points for the first Bzier segment. Then, for each additional segment of the curve, you specify a vertex and two control points. The last point that you specify is the ending vertex for the curve. Note that you must always specify 3n + 1 points, where n is the number of segments in the curve.

methods.name: AddLabel
methods.signature: AddLabel(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a label. Returns a Shape object that represents the new label.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The text orientation within the label.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the label relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the label relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the label, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the label, in points.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.signature: AddLine(BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: As it applies to the Shapes object, returns a Shape object that represents the new line on a worksheet.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

methods.name: AddPicture
methods.signature: AddPicture(Filename As String, LinkToFile As MsoTriState, SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a picture from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new picture.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the picture is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: The file to link to. Use msoFalse to make the picture an independent copy of the file. Use msoTrue to link the picture to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: To save the picture with the document. Use msoFalse to store only the link information in the document. Use msoTrue to save the linked picture with the document into which it's inserted. This argument must be msoTrue if _LinkToFile_ is msoFalse.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the picture relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the picture relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, in points (enter -1 to retain the width of the existing file).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, in points (enter -1 to retain the height of the existing file).

methods.name: AddPolyline
methods.description: Creates an open polyline or a closed polygon drawing. Returns a Shape object that represents the new polyline or polygon.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the polyline drawing's vertices.

methods.name: AddShape
methods.signature: AddShape(Type As MsoAutoShapeType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the new AutoShape on a worksheet.

parameters.name: Type

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the AutoShape's bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the AutoShape's bounding box relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the AutoShape's bounding box, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the AutoShape's bounding box, in points.

methods.name: AddTextEffect
methods.signature: AddTextEffect(PresetTextEffect As MsoPresetTextEffect, Text As String, FontName As String, FontSize As Single, FontBold As MsoTriState, FontItalic As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single) As Shape

parameters.name: FontSize

parameters.name: FontBold

parameters.name: Top

parameters.name: Top

parameters.description: The height of the text box, in points.

methods.description: Creates a Microsoft Excel control. Returns a Shape object that represents the new control.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The Microsoft Excel control type. You cannot create an edit box on a worksheet.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The initial coordinates of the new object (in points) relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet or to the upper-left corner of a chart.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The initial coordinates of the new object (in points) relative to the top of row 1 on a worksheet, or to the top of the chart area on a chart.

parameters.name: Width

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The initial size of the new object, in points.

methods.name: AddOLEObject
methods.signature: AddOLEObject([ClassType As Variant], [Filename As Variant], [Link As Variant], [DisplayAsIcon As Variant], [IconFileName As Variant], [IconIndex As Variant], [IconLabel As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an OLE object. Returns a Shape object that represents the new OLE object.

parameters.name: ClassType
parameters.description: A string that contains the programmatic identifier for the object to be created. You must specify either _ClassType_ or _FileName_. If _ClassType_ is specified, _FileName_ and _Link_ are ignored.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the object is to be created. If the path isn't specified, the current working folder is used. You must specify either the _ClassType_ or _FileName_ argument for the object, but not both.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: True to link the OLE object to the file from which it was created. False to make the OLE object an independent copy of the file. If you specified a value for _ClassType_, this argument must be False. The default value is False.

parameters.name: DisplayAsIcon
parameters.description: True to display the OLE object as an icon. The default value is False.

parameters.name: IconFileName
parameters.description: The file that contains the icon to be displayed.

parameters.name: IconIndex
parameters.description: The index of the icon within _IconFileName_. The order of icons in the specified file corresponds to the order in which the icons appear in the Change Icon dialog box (accessed from the Object dialog box when the Display as icon check box is selected). The first icon in the file has the index number 0 (zero). If an icon with the given index number doesn't exist in _IconFileName_, the icon with the index number 1 (the second icon in the file) is used. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: IconLabel
parameters.description: A label (caption) to be displayed beneath the icon.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the new object relative to the upper-left corner of the document. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the new object relative to the top of the document. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The initial dimensions of the OLE object, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The initial dimensions of the OLE object, in points.

parameters.name: Height

methods.description: Creates a picture from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new picture.

parameters.name: Filename

parameters.name: LinkToFile

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the picture relative to the top edge of the worksheet.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: Compress
parameters.description: Determines whether the picture should be compressed when inserted.

methods.signature: Add3DModel(Filename As String, [LinkToFile As Variant], [SaveWithDocument As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a 3D model from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new 3D model.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the 3D model is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Determines whether the 3D model will be linked to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Determines whether the linked 3D model will be saved with the document into which it is inserted.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the 3D model relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top

types.name: Sort
types.description: Represents a sort of a range of data.
types.example:
Sub SortData()

 'Building data to sort on the active sheet.
 Range("A1").Value = "Name"
 Range("A2").Value = "Bill"
 Range("A3").Value = "Rod"
 Range("A4").Value = "John"
 Range("A5").Value = "Paddy"
 Range("A6").Value = "Kelly"
 Range("A7").Value = "William"
 Range("A8").Value = "Janet"
 Range("A9").Value = "Florence"
 Range("A10").Value = "Albert"
 Range("A11").Value = "Mary"
 MsgBox "The list is out of order. Hit Ok to continue...", vbInformation

 'Selecting a cell within the range.
 Range("A2").Select

 'Applying sort.
 With ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(ActiveSheet.Name).Sort
 .SortFields.Clear
 .SortFields.Add Key:=Range("A2:A11"), _
 SortOn:=xlSortOnValues, Order:=xlAscending, DataOption:=xlSortNormal
 .SetRange Range("A1:A11")
 .Header = xlYes
 .MatchCase = False
 .Orientation = xlTopToBottom
 .SortMethod = xlPinYin
 .Apply
 End With
 MsgBox "Sort complete.", vbInformation

End Sub

methods.name: Speak
methods.signature: Speak(Text As String, [SpeakAsync As Variant], [SpeakXML As Variant], [Purge As Variant])
methods.description: Microsoft Excel plays back the text string that is passed as an argument.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text to be spoken.

parameters.name: SpeakAsync
parameters.description: True causes the text to be spoken asynchronously (the method will not wait for the text to be spoken). False causes the text to be spoken synchronously (the method waits for the text to be spoken before continuing). The default is False.

parameters.name: SpeakXML
parameters.description: True causes the text to be interpreted as XML. False causes the text to not be interpreted as XML, so any XML tags are read and not interpreted. The default is False.

parameters.name: Purge
parameters.description: True causes current speech to be terminated and any buffered text to be purged before text is spoken. False does not cause the current speech to be terminated and does not purge the buffered text before text is spoken. The default is False.

types.name: SpellingOptions
types.description: Represents the various spell checking options for a worksheet.
types.remarks: Use the SpellingOptions property of the Application object to return a SpellingOptions object. After a SpellingOptions object is returned, you can use the following properties to set or return various spell checking options: - ArabicModes - DictLang - GermanPostReform - HebrewModes - IgnoreCaps - IgnoreFileNames - IgnoreMixedDigits - KoreanCombineAux - KoreanProcessCompound - KoreanUseAutoChangeList - SuggestMainOnly - UserDict
types.example:
Sub IgnoreAllCAPS()

 ' Place misspelled versions of the same word in all caps and mixed case.
 Range("A1").Formula = "Testt"
 Range("A2").Formula = "TESTT"

 With Application.SpellingOptions
 .SuggestMainOnly = True
 .IgnoreCaps = True
 End With

 ' Run a spell check.
 Cells.CheckSpelling

End Sub

types.name: Style
types.description: Represents a style description for a range.
types.remarks: The Style object contains all style attributes (font, number format, alignment, and so on) as properties. There are several built-in styles, including Normal, Currency, and Percent. Using the Style object is a fast and efficient way to change several cell-formatting properties on multiple cells at the same time. For the Workbook object, the Style object is a member of the Styles collection. The Styles collection contains all the defined styles for the workbook. You can change the appearance of a cell by changing properties of the style applied to that cell. Keep in mind, however, that changing a style property affects all cells already formatted with that style. Styles are sorted alphabetically by style name. The style index number denotes the position of the specified style in the sorted list of style names. Styles(1) is the first style in the alphabetic list, and Styles(Styles.Count) is the last one in the list. For more information about creating and modifying a style, see the Styles object.
types.example: Worksheets("Sheet1").Range("A1:A10").Style = "Percent"

types.remarks: Use the Tab property of the Chart object or Worksheet object to return a Tab object. After a Tab object is returned, you can use the ColorIndex property to determine the settings of a tab for a chart or worksheet.

Sub CheckTab()

 If Worksheets(1).Tab.ColorIndex = xlColorIndexNone Then

 "worksheet tab."

Sub CreateTable()

types.remarks: This object isn't a collection. There's no object that represents a single tick-mark label; you must return all the tick-mark labels as a unit. Tick-mark label text for the category axis comes from the name of the associated category in the chart. The default tick-mark label text for the category axis is the number that indicates the position of the category relative to the left end of this axis. To change the number of unlabeled tick marks between tick-mark labels, you must change the TickLabelSpacing property for the category axis. Tick-mark label text for the value axis is calculated based on the MajorUnit, MinimumScale, and MaximumScale properties of the value axis. To change the tick-mark label text for the value axis, you must change the values of these properties.

 .Axes(xlValue).TickLabels.NumberFormat = "0.00"

types.name: Top10
types.description: Represents a top ten visual of a conditional formatting rule. Applying a color to a range helps you see the value of a cell relative to other cells.
types.remarks: All conditional formatting objects are contained within a FormatConditions collection object, which is a child of a Range collection. You can create a top 10 formatting rule by using either the Add or AddTop10 method of the FormatConditions collection.
types.example:
Sub Top10CF()

' Building data
 Range("A1").Value = "Name"
 Range("B1").Value = "Number"
 Range("A2").Value = "Agent1"
 Range("A2").AutoFill Destination:=Range("A2:A26"), Type:=xlFillDefault
 Range("B2:B26").FormulaArray = "=INT(RAND()*101)"
 Range("B2:B26").Select

' Applying Conditional Formatting Top 10
 Selection.FormatConditions.AddTop10
 Selection.FormatConditions(Selection.FormatConditions.Count).SetFirstPriority
 With Selection.FormatConditions(1)
 .TopBottom = xlTop10Top
 .Rank = 10
 .Percent = False
 End With

' Applying color fill
 With Selection.FormatConditions(1).Font
 .Color = -16752384
 .TintAndShade = 0
 End With
 With Selection.FormatConditions(1).Interior
 .PatternColorIndex = xlAutomatic
 .Color = 13561798
 .TintAndShade = 0
 End With
MsgBox "Added Top10 Conditional Format. Press F9 to update values.", vbInformation

End Sub

properties.name: ErrorTitle

properties.name: InputMessage

properties.name: InputTitle
properties.description: Returns or sets the title of the data-validation input dialog box. Read/write String. Limited to 32 characters.

properties.name: Formula1
properties.description: Returns the value or expression associated with the conditional format or data validation. Can be a constant value, a string value, a cell reference, or a formula. Read-only String.

properties.name: Formula2

Used only when the data validation conditional format Operator property is xlBetween or xlNotBetween (XlFormatConditionOperator). properties.name: Operator
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the operator for the data validation. See XlFormatConditionOperator.

properties.name: ShowError
properties.description: True if the data validation error message will be displayed whenever the user enters invalid data. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowInput
properties.description: True if the data validation input message will be displayed whenever the user selects a cell in the data validation range. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns a Long value containing an XlDVType constant that represents the data type validation for a range.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value that indicates if all the validation criteria are met (that is, if the range contains valid data).

parameters.description: The first part of the data validation equation. Value must not exceed 255 characters.

parameters.name: Formula2

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the object.

parameters.description: An XlDVType value that represents the validation type.

parameters.name: AlertStyle
parameters.description: An XlDVAlertStyle value that represents the validation alert style.

parameters.name: Operator
parameters.description: An XlFormatConditionOperator value that represents the data validation operator.

parameters.name: Formula1
parameters.description: The first part of the data validation equation.

parameters.name: Formula2
parameters.description: The second part of the data validation equation when Operator is xlBetween or xlNotBetween; otherwise, this argument is ignored.

types.name: ValueChange
types.description: Represents a value that has been changed in a PivotTable report that is based on an OLAP data source.
types.remarks: The PivotTableChangeList collection contains ValueChange objects that represent changes that a user has made to value cells in a PivotTable report. The properties of the ValueChange object specify details about the change that was made, such as the value of the change, the tuple associated with the cell that was changed, the order in which the change was made relative to other changes, and whether the cell is visible in the PivotTable. The ValueChange object also provides the PivotCell property that returns a PivotCell object that represents the cell that was changed, and provides additional information about the changed cell.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates the order in which this change was performed relative to other changes in the PivotTableChangeList collection. Read-only.

properties.name: VisibleInPivotTable
properties.description: Returns whether the cell (tuple) is currently visible in the PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: PivotCell
properties.description: Returns a PivotCell object that represents the cell (tuple) that was changed. Read-only.

properties.name: Tuple
properties.description: Returns the MDX tuple of the value that was changed in the OLAP data source. Read-only.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns the value that the user entered in the cell or that the formula in the cell was evaluated to when the UPDATE CUBE statement was last run against the OLAP data source. Read-only.

properties.name: AllocationValue
properties.description: Returns the value to allocate when performing what-if analysis. Read-only.

properties.name: AllocationMethod
properties.description: Returns the method to use to allocate this value when performing what-if analysis. Read-only.

properties.name: AllocationWeightExpression
properties.description: Returns the MDX weight expression to use for this value when performing what-if analysis. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified ValueChange object from the PivotTableChangeList collection.

types.name: VPageBreak
types.description: Represents a vertical page break.
types.remarks: The VPageBreak object is a member of the VPageBreaks collection.
types.example:
Dim r as Range
Set r = Worksheets(1).VPageBreaks(1).Location

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPageBreak value that represents the page break type.

properties.name: Extent
properties.description: Returns the type of the specified page break: full-screen or only within a print area. Can be either of the following XlPageBreakExtent constants: xlPageBreakFull or xlPageBreakPartial. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns the cell (a Range object) that defines the page-break location. Vertical page breaks are aligned with the left edge of the location cell. Read-only Range.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the object.

methods.name: DragOff
methods.signature: DragOff(Direction As XlDirection, RegionIndex As Long)
methods.description: Drags a page break out of the print area.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The direction in which the page break is dragged.

parameters.name: RegionIndex
parameters.description: The print-area region index for the page break (the region where the mouse pointer is located when the mouse button is pressed if the user drags the page break). If the print area is contiguous, there's only one print region. If the print area is discontiguous, there's more than one print region.

types.name: VPageBreaks
types.description: A collection of vertical page breaks within the print area.
types.remarks: Each vertical page break is represented by a VPageBreak object. When the Application property, Count property, Creator property, Item property, Parent property, or Add method is used in conjunction with the VPageBreaks property: - For an automatic print area, the VPageBreaks property applies only to the page breaks within the print area. - For a user-defined print area of the same range, the VPageBreaks property applies to all of the page breaks.
types.example: ActiveSheet.VPageBreaks.Add Before:=ActiveCell

types.name: Watch
types.description: Represents a range that is tracked when the worksheet is recalculated. The Watch object allows users to verify the accuracy of their models and debug problems that they encounter.
types.remarks: The Watch object is a member of the Watches collection.
types.example:
Sub AddWatch()

 With Application
 .Range("A1").Formula = 1
 .Range("A2").Formula = 2
 .Range("A3").Formula = "=Sum(A1:A2)"
 .Range("A3").Select
 .Watches.Add Source:=ActiveCell
 End With

End Sub

 End With

End Sub

types.name: WebOptions
types.description: Contains workbook-level attributes used by Microsoft Excel when you save a document as a webpage or open a webpage.
types.remarks: You can return or set attributes either at the application (global) level or at the workbook level. (Note that attribute values can be different from one workbook to another, depending on the attribute value at the time the workbook was saved.) Workbook-level attribute settings override application-level attribute settings. Application-level attributes are contained in the DefaultWebOptions object.
types.example:
Set objAppWebOptions = Workbooks(1).WebOptions
With objAppWebOptions
 If .AllowPNG = True Then
 strImageFileType = "PNG"
 Else
 strImageFileType = "JPG"
 End If
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: RelyOnCSS
properties.description: True if cascading style sheets (CSS) are used for font formatting when you view a saved document in a web browser. Microsoft Excel creates a cascading style sheet file and saves it either to the specified folder or to the same folder as your webpage, depending on the value of the OrganizeInFolder property. False if HTML <FONT> tags and cascading style sheets are used. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: OrganizeInFolder
properties.description: True if all supporting files, such as background textures and graphics, are organized in a separate folder when you save the specified document as a webpage. False if supporting files are saved in the same folder as the webpage. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UseLongFileNames
properties.description: True if long file names are used when you save the document as a webpage. False if long file names are not used and the DOS file name format (8.3) is used. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DownloadComponents
properties.description: True if the necessary Microsoft Office Web components are downloaded when you view the saved document in a web browser, but only if the components are not already installed. False if the components are not downloaded. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RelyOnVML
properties.description: True if image files are not generated from drawing objects when you save a document as a webpage. False if images are generated. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AllowPNG
properties.description: True if Portable Network Graphics (PNG) is allowed as an image format when you save documents as a webpage. False if PNG is not allowed as an output format. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ScreenSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the ideal minimum screen size (width by height, in pixels) that you should use when viewing the saved document in a web browser. Can be one of the MsoScreenSize constants. The default constant is msoScreenSize800x600. Read/write MsoScreenSize.

properties.name: PixelsPerInch
properties.description: Returns or sets the density (pixels per inch) of graphics images and table cells on a webpage. The range of settings is usually from 19 to 480, and common settings for popular screen sizes are 72, 96, and 120. The default setting is 96. Read/write Long.

properties.name: LocationOfComponents
properties.description: Returns or sets the central URL (on the intranet or web) or path (local or network) to the location from which authorized users can download Microsoft Office Web components when viewing your saved document. The default value is the local or network installation path for Microsoft Office. Read/write String.

properties.name: Encoding
properties.description: Returns or sets the document encoding (code page or character set) to be used by the web browser when you view the saved document. The default is the system code page. Read/write MsoEncoding.

properties.name: FolderSuffix
properties.description: Returns the folder suffix that Microsoft Excel uses when you save a document as a webpage, use long file names, and choose to save supporting files in a separate folder (that is, if the UseLongFileNames and OrganizeInFolder properties are set to True). Read-only String.

properties.name: TargetBrowser
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTargetBrowser constant indicating the browser version. Read/write.

methods.name: UseDefaultFolderSuffix
methods.description: Sets the folder suffix for the specified document to the default suffix for the language support that you have selected or installed.

types.name: Window
types.description: Represents a window.
types.remarks: Many worksheet characteristics, such as scroll bars and gridlines, are actually properties of the window. The Window object is a member of the Windows collection. The Windows collection for the Application object contains all the windows in the application, whereas the Windows collection for the Workbook object contains only the windows in the specified workbook.
types.example: Windows(1).WindowState = xlMaximized

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveCell
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the active cell in the active window (the window on top) or in the specified window. If the window isn't displaying a worksheet, this property fails. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveChart
properties.description: Returns a Chart object that represents the active chart (either an embedded chart or a chart sheet). An embedded chart is considered active when it's either selected or activated. When no chart is active, this property returns Nothing.

properties.name: ActivePane
properties.description: Returns a Pane object that represents the active pane in the window. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveSheet
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the active sheet (the sheet on top) in the active workbook or in the specified window or workbook. Returns Nothing if no sheet is active.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the name that appears in the title bar of the document window.

properties.name: DisplayFormulas
properties.description: True if the window is displaying formulas; False if the window is displaying values. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayGridlines
properties.description: True if gridlines are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayHeadings
properties.description: True if both row and column headings are displayed; False if no headings are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayHorizontalScrollBar
properties.description: True if the horizontal scroll bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayOutline
properties.description: True if outline symbols are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayVerticalScrollBar
properties.description: True if the vertical scroll bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayWorkbookTabs
properties.description: True if the workbook tabs are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayZeros
properties.description: True if zero values are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableResize
properties.description: True if the window can be resized. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FreezePanes
properties.description: True if split panes are frozen. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GridlineColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the gridline color as an RGB value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: GridlineColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the gridline color as an index into the current color palette or as an XlColorIndex constant.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the window.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the client area to the left edge of the window.

properties.name: OnWindow
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the procedure that's run whenever you activate a window. Read/write String.

properties.name: Panes
properties.description: Returns a Panes collection that represents all the panes in the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: RangeSelection
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the selected cells on the worksheet in the specified window even if a graphic object is active or selected on the worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: ScrollColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the leftmost column in the pane or window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ScrollRow
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the row that appears at the top of the pane or window. Read/write Long.

properties.name: SelectedSheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the selected sheets in the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: Selection
properties.description: Returns the specified window, for a Windows object.

properties.name: Split
properties.description: True if the window is split. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SplitColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets the column number where the window is split into panes (the number of columns to the left of the split line). Read/write Long.

properties.name: SplitHorizontal
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the horizontal window split, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: SplitRow
properties.description: Returns or sets the row number where the window is split into panes (the number of rows above the split). Read/write Long.

properties.name: SplitVertical
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the vertical window split, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: TabRatio
properties.description: Returns or sets the ratio of the width of the workbook's tab area to the width of the window's horizontal scroll bar (as a number between 0 (zero) and 1; the default value is 0.6). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the window to the top edge of the usable area (below the menus, any toolbars docked at the top, and the formula bar).

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlWindowType value that represents the window type.

properties.name: UsableHeight
properties.description: Returns the maximum height of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: UsableWidth
properties.description: Returns the maximum width of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: VisibleRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range of cells that are visible in the window or pane. If a column or row is partially visible, it's included in the range. Read-only.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the window.

properties.name: WindowNumber
properties.description: Returns the window number. For example, a window named Book1.xls:2 has 2 as its window number. Most windows have the window number 1. Read-only Long.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the window. Read/write XlWindowState.

properties.name: Zoom
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the display size of the window, as a percentage (100 equals normal size, 200 equals double size, and so on).

properties.name: View
properties.description: Returns or sets the view showing in the window. Read/write XlWindowView.

properties.name: DisplayRightToLeft
properties.description: True if the specified window is displayed from right to left instead of from left to right. False if the object is displayed from left to right. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: SheetViews
properties.description: Returns the SheetViews object for the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveSheetView
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the view of the active sheet in the specified window. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayRuler
properties.description: True if a ruler is displayed for the specified window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoFilterDateGrouping
properties.description: True if the auto filter for date grouping is currently displayed in the specified window. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayWhitespace
properties.description: True if whitespace is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Hwnd
properties.description: Returns a Long that indicates the window handle of the specified window. Read-only.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Brings the window to the front of the z-order.

methods.name: ActivateNext
methods.description: Activates the specified window and then sends it to the back of the window z-order.

methods.name: ActivatePrevious
methods.description: Activates the specified window and then activates the window at the back of the window z-order.

methods.name: Close
methods.signature: Close([SaveChanges As Variant], [Filename As Variant], [RouteWorkbook As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Closes the object.

parameters.name: SaveChanges
parameters.description: If there are no changes to the workbook, this argument is ignored. If there are changes to the workbook and the workbook appears in other open windows, this argument is ignored. If there are changes to the workbook but the workbook doesn't appear in any other open windows, this argument specifies whether changes should be saved.If set to True, changes are saved to the workbook. If there is not yet a file name associated with the workbook, _FileName_ is used. If _FileName_ is omitted, the user is asked to supply a file name.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: Save changes under this file name.

parameters.name: RouteWorkbook
parameters.description: If the workbook doesn't need to be routed to the next recipient (if it has no routing slip or has already been routed), this argument is ignored. Otherwise, Microsoft Excel routes the workbook according to the value of this parameter. If set to True, the workbook is sent to the next recipient. If set to False, the workbook is not sent. If omitted, the user is asked whether the workbook should be sent.

parameters.name: ToLeft

methods.name: PrintPreview

parameters.name: EnableChanges

methods.name: ScrollWorkbookTabs
methods.signature: ScrollWorkbookTabs([Sheets As Variant], [Position As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls through the workbook tabs at the bottom of the window. Doesn't affect the active sheet in the workbook.

parameters.name: Sheets
parameters.description: The number of sheets to scroll by. Use a positive number to scroll forward, a negative number to scroll backward, or 0 (zero) to not scroll at all. You must specify _Sheets_ if you don't specify _Position_.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Use xlFirst to scroll to the first sheet, or use xlLast to scroll to the last sheet. You must specify _Position_ if you don't specify _Sheets_.

methods.name: SmallScroll
methods.signature: SmallScroll([Down As Variant], [Up As Variant], [ToRight As Variant], [ToLeft As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Scrolls the contents of the window by rows or columns.

parameters.name: Down
parameters.description: The number of rows to scroll the contents down.

parameters.name: Up
parameters.description: The number of rows to scroll the contents up.

parameters.name: ToRight
parameters.description: The number of columns to scroll the contents to the right.

parameters.name: ToLeft
parameters.description: The number of columns to scroll the contents to the left.

methods.name: PointsToScreenPixelsX
methods.description: Converts a horizontal measurement from points (document coordinates) to screen pixels (screen coordinates). Returns the converted measurement as a Long value.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The number of points horizontally along the top of the document window, starting from the left.

methods.name: PointsToScreenPixelsY
methods.description: Converts a vertical measurement from points (document coordinates) to screen pixels (screen coordinates). Returns the converted measurement as a Long value.

parameters.name: Points
parameters.description: The number of points vertically along the left edge of the document window, starting from the top.

methods.name: RangeFromPoint
methods.signature: RangeFromPoint(x As Long, y As Long) As Object
methods.description: Returns the Shape or Range object that is positioned at the specified pair of screen coordinates. If there isn't a shape located at the specified coordinates, this method returns Nothing.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The value (in pixels) that represents the horizontal distance from the left edge of the screen, starting at the top.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The value (in pixels) that represents the vertical distance from the top of the screen, starting on the left.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.signature: ScrollIntoView(Left As Long, Top As Long, Width As Long, Height As Long, [Start As Variant])
methods.description: Scrolls the document window so that the contents of a specified rectangular area are displayed in either the upper-left or lower-right corner of the document window or pane (depending on the value of the _Start_ argument).

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The horizontal position of the rectangle (in points) from the left edge of the document window or pane.

parameters.name: Top

types.name: Workbook
types.description: Represents a Microsoft Excel workbook.
types.remarks: The Workbook object is a member of the Workbooks collection. The Workbooks collection contains all the Workbook objects currently open in Microsoft Excel. The ThisWorkbook property of the Application object returns the workbook where the Visual Basic code is running. In most cases, this is the same as the active workbook. However, if the Visual Basic code is part of an add-in, the ThisWorkbook property won't return the active workbook. In this case, the active workbook is the workbook calling the add-in, whereas the ThisWorkbook property returns the add-in workbook. If you are creating an add-in from your Visual Basic code, you should use the ThisWorkbook property to qualify any statement that must be run on the workbook that you compile into the add-in.

methods.name: SendForReview

methods.description: Sends a workbook in an email message for review to the specified recipients.

parameters.name: Recipients
parameters.description: A string that lists the people to whom to send the message. These can be unresolved names and aliases in an email phone book or full email addresses. Separate multiple recipients with a semicolon (;). If left blank and _ShowMessage_ is False, you'll receive an error message, and the message will not be sent.

parameters.name: Subject
parameters.description: A string for the subject of the message. If left blank, the subject will be: Please review "filename".

parameters.name: ShowMessage
parameters.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the message should be displayed when the method is executed. The default value is True. If set to False, the message is automatically sent to the recipients without first showing the message to the sender.

parameters.name: IncludeAttachment
parameters.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the message should include an attachment or a link to a server location. The default value is True. If set to False, the document must be stored at a shared location.

methods.name: ReplyWithChanges

methods.name: Protect
methods.signature: Protect([Password As Variant], [Structure As Variant], [Windows As Variant])
methods.description: Protects a workbook so that it cannot be modified.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A string that specifies a case-sensitive password for the worksheet or workbook. If this argument is omitted, you can unprotect the worksheet or workbook without using a password. Otherwise, you must specify the password to unprotect the worksheet or workbook. If you forget the password, you cannot unprotect the worksheet or workbook. Use strong passwords that combine uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Weak passwords don't mix these elements. Strong password: Y6dh!et5. Weak password: House27. Passwords should be 8 or more characters in length. A pass phrase that uses 14 or more characters is better. It's critical that you remember your password. If you forget your password, Microsoft cannot retrieve it. Store the passwords that you write down in a secure place away from the information that they help protect.

parameters.name: Structure
parameters.description: True to protect the structure of the workbook (the relative position of the sheets). The default value is False.

parameters.name: Windows
parameters.description: True to protect the workbook windows. If this argument is omitted, the windows aren't protected.

parameters.name: Subject

parameters.name: ShowMessage

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: A uniform resource locator (URL) or a uniform naming convention (UNC) path to an XML data file.

parameters.name: ImportMap
parameters.description: The schema map to apply when importing the file. If the data was previously imported, contains a reference to the XmlMap object containing the data.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: If a value is not specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite data that has been mapped to the schema map specified in the _ImportMap_ parameter. Set to True to overwrite the data or False to append the new data to the existing data. The default value is True. If a value is specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite existing data. Set to True to overwrite existing data or False to cancel the import if data would be overwritten. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specifies the range where the list will be created. You only use the top-left corner of the range.

methods.name: XmlImportXml
methods.signature: XmlImportXml(Data As String, ImportMap As XmlMap, [Overwrite As Variant], [Destination As Variant]) As XlXmlImportResult

parameters.name: Data

parameters.name: ImportMap

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: If a value is not specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite data that has been mapped to the schema map specified in the _ImportMap_ parameter. Set to True to overwrite the data or False to append the new data to the existing data. The default value is True. If a value is specified for the _Destination_ parameter, this parameter specifies whether to overwrite existing data. Set to True to overwrite existing data or False to cancel the import if data would be overwritten. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specifies the range where the list will be created. Excel only uses the top-left corner of the range.

methods.name: SaveAs
methods.signature: SaveAs([Filename As Variant], [FileFormat As Variant], [Password As Variant], [WriteResPassword As Variant], [ReadOnlyRecommended As Variant], [CreateBackup As Variant], [AccessMode As XlSaveAsAccessMode], [ConflictResolution As Variant], [AddToMru As Variant], [TextCodepage As Variant], [TextVisualLayout As Variant], [Local As Variant], [WorkIdentity As Variant])
methods.description: Saves changes to the workbook in a different file.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: A string that indicates the name of the file to be saved. You can include a full path; if you don't, Microsoft Excel saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: FileFormat
parameters.description: The file format to use when you save the file. For a list of valid choices, see the XlFileFormat enumeration. For an existing file, the default format is the last file format specified; for a new file, the default is the format of the version of Excel being used.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: A case-sensitive string (no more than 15 characters) that indicates the protection password to be given to the file.

parameters.name: WriteResPassword
parameters.description: A string that indicates the write-reservation password for this file. If a file is saved with the password and the password isn't supplied when the file is opened, the file is opened as read-only.

parameters.name: ReadOnlyRecommended
parameters.description: True to display a message when the file is opened, recommending that the file be opened as read-only.

parameters.name: CreateBackup
parameters.description: True to create a backup file.

parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description: The access mode for the workbook.

parameters.name: ConflictResolution
parameters.description: An XlSaveConflictResolution value that determines how the method resolves a conflict while saving the workbook. If set to xlUserResolution, the conflict-resolution dialog box is displayed. If set to xlLocalSessionChanges, the local user's changes are automatically accepted. If set to xlOtherSessionChanges, the changes from other sessions are automatically accepted instead of the local user's changes. If this argument is omitted, the conflict-resolution dialog box is displayed.

parameters.name: AddToMru
parameters.description: True to add this workbook to the list of recently used files. The default value is False.

parameters.name: TextCodepage
parameters.description: Ignored for all languages in Microsoft Excel. NOTE: When Excel saves a workbook to one of the CSV or text formats, which are specified by using the _FileFormat_ parameter, it uses the code page that corresponds to the language for the system locale in use on the current computer. This system setting is available in the Control Panel > Region and Language > Location tab under Current location.

parameters.name: TextVisualLayout
parameters.description: Ignored for all languages in Microsoft Excel. NOTE: When Excel saves a workbook to one of the CSV or text formats, which are specified by using the _FileFormat_ parameter, it saves these formats in logical layout. If left-to-right (LTR) text is embedded within right-to-left (RTL) text in the file, or vice versa, logical layout saves the contents of the file in the correct reading order for all languages in the file without regard to direction. When an application opens the file, each run of LTR or RTL characters are rendered in the correct direction according to the character value ranges within the code page (unless an application that is designed to display the exact memory layout of the file, such as a debugger or editor, is used to open the file).

parameters.name: Local
parameters.description: True saves files against the language of Microsoft Excel (including control panel settings). False (default) saves files against the language of Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) (which is typically US English unless the VBA project where Workbooks.Open is run from is an old internationalized XL5/95 VBA project).

types.name: WorkbookConnection
types.description: A connection is a set of information needed to obtain data from an external data source other than a Microsoft Excel workbook.
types.remarks: Connections can be stored within an Excel workbook. When the workbook is opened, Excel creates an in-memory copy of the connection that is referred to as the connection object. A connection object contains information such as the name of the server and the name of the object to be opened on that server. Optionally, the connection object may also include authentication credentials and/or a command that is to be passed to the server and executed (example: a SELECT statement to be executed by SQL Server). A connection may also be stored in a separate connection file. Most connections in an Excel workbook include a pointer to an external connection file. Connection files have extensions that clearly label them as connection files (.ODC, .IQY, etc.) and may be located on the user's local machine or in other well-known or trusted locations such as WSS (Data Connection Library), or other corporate servers. Connection files enable multiple users within the same organization to re-use connections. Network administrators are able to change the way the entire organization connects to a back-end data source by changing a single connection file.

methods.description: Creates a new workbook. The new workbook becomes the active workbook.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description: Determines how the new workbook is created. If this argument is a string specifying the name of an existing Microsoft Excel file, the new workbook is created with the specified file as a template. If this argument is a constant, the new workbook contains a single sheet of the specified type. Can be one of the following XlWBATemplate constants: xlWBATChart, xlWBATExcel4IntlMacroSheet, xlWBATExcel4MacroSheet, or xlWBATWorksheet. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel creates a new workbook with a number of blank sheets (the number of sheets is set by the SheetsInNewWorkbook property).

methods.name: Close
